summary: Paired transaction prepare and finalize hooks distinguish managed source capture from earlier raw commits

replay.detail: No historical capture adoption or automatic recovery/backfill.

schema.detail: The foundation adds no tables or capture triggers; markers and gap state belong to the source adapter.

rules.detail: Admission, canonical ordering, authority and checkpoint rules remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Managed WriterGuard transaction begin methods return anyhow::Result to retain prepare failure causes. Finalizer-only installation remains a no-op-prepare convenience.

downtime.detail: No production adapter activation or restart.

manual.detail: The single adapter prepares inside the outer transaction before source helpers, checks preexisting capture gaps and clears its managed-scope marker before commit.

recovery.detail: Prepare failures roll back their SQL and skip source/finalize work. Uncovered earlier raw commits stay fenced and cannot be relabeled as current transaction input.
